subject: docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-101.turn2.draft.md
summary: Turn 2 removes sysctl.proc_cputype as a process-architecture field, uses the accepted H+E+D+single-arch-spawn-preference+target-P_TRANSLATED=0 derivation, removes the claim that suspension itself detects a path swap, adds the required macOS path/inode/digest rechecks, and preserves every other attacked invariant. The repair creates a new measurement contradiction, however: the macOS full-file SHA-256 recheck is required immediately before each timed launch, while every cold launch is required to be the first exec after a cache purge. Rehashing P after that purge reads P back into the filesystem cache unless a cache-bypassing method is required; none is. The resulting G03 cold series is not cold-cache evidence. One MUST-FIX prohibits CONSENT and the proposed condition-4 MET transition.

objections.title: The just-in-time macOS digest recheck repopulates the cache before every purported cold launch
objections.finding: Lines 81-85 and 95-100 require purge, then a cold launch as the first exec after that purge, followed immediately by its warm launch. Lines 146-151 and 220-224 independently require stat plus a repeated SHA-256 of P immediately before every macOS timed launch. Recomputing SHA-256 over P necessarily reads all of P. Ordinary macOS file reads populate the filesystem buffer cache; the draft specifies neither F_NOCACHE nor another cache-neutral digest mechanism. For a cold sample, the required ordering is therefore purge -> read all candidate bytes to rehash -> exec candidate, so the candidate image has just been warmed by the identity check. For the warm sample, the same check also inserts a full-file hash workload between the cold and supposedly immediate warm launches. This is a contradiction in the normative measurement sequence, not merely an implementation detail.
evidence: D-101 turn 2 lines 81-85 define the first-release purge/cold/immediate-warm sequence; lines 95-104 define the equivalent paired sequence from the second release onward.
D-101 turn 2 lines 146-151 and 220-224 require the inode and full digest check immediately before each macOS timed launch.

Apple's File-System Performance Tips states that macOS maintains a buffer cache containing recently read file data and directs one-shot readers to disable caching explicitly; it names fcntl(F_NOCACHE) for that purpose: https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/Performance/Conceptual/FileSystem/Articles/FilePerformance.html
Apple's fcntl(2) manual defines F_NOCACHE as turning data caching off or on: https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/System/Conceptual/ManPages_iPhoneOS/man2/fcntl.2.html

MacOSX15.4.sdk usr/include/sys/fcntl.h defines F_NOCACHE as 'turn data caching off/on for this fd' at line 252; its SHA-256 is ebe22134742232b94f282575ff1fd901ac8b834976aab8d988ea0b37b0c52f85. The draft does not require it or any tested equivalent.
objections.impact: The governed macOS cold p50/p95/p99 samples can measure a digest-warmed executable while being labeled cold-cache. Those are three of D-006's five operative G03 quantities and can determine both the absolute qualification gate and the paired 10 percent gate. A contract that systematically contaminates those samples cannot back the G03 identifier or the claim that all required condition-4 harnesses are validly named.
objections.requiredRepair: Define one non-contradictory, reviewable sequence that preserves both executable identity and cache state. For example, require and validate a cache-bypassing full-file read such as a correctly implemented F_NOCACHE digest path, with no cache-populating helper exec, and state how the immediate warm pair remains uncontaminated; or bind an immutable opened object and its inode/digest before a final purge, then use a cache-neutral path-to-object check immediately before exec and revalidate after the pair. In either design, no full-file cache-populating read may occur after the final cold purge, and no unaccounted digest workload may occur inside the cold/warm pair. Retain rejection and preflight rerun on any identity mismatch.

predecessorFindingDisposition.D101-T1-MF-1: RESOLVED-VERIFIED. sysctl.proc_cputype+PID is expressly rejected, not used as process architecture. macOS target ISA is the accepted fail-closed H, thin E, digest D0, one exact spawn preference, and target P_TRANSLATED=0 derivation.
predecessorFindingDisposition.ADV-D101-T1-01: RESOLVED-AS-WRITTEN, WITH NEW DEFECT ADV-D101-T2-01. The unsupported claim that suspension itself detects a swap is gone, and path/inode/digest checks now occur before spawn, after target observations, and before each macOS timed launch. The new objection is not a residual missing check; it is the cache-state contamination caused by where the added full digest check is ordered.
